messages:
maya: Quick idea — run a 'first-5' activation experiment: give new accounts 100 free tokens unlocked after their first 5 API requests, plus a bundled starter prompt pack in the console. Goal = move M0->M1 in 7 days (engaged devs who make >10 calls/day).
sam: Nice. How do we gate it? feature flag + canary %?
jules: Love bundling prompt templates. Can we surface 3 templates in the quickstart modal and add a CTA to sign up for the short webinar (15m) that covers prompt best practices? We can A/B test modal copy.
noah: Metrics I care about: 7-day DAU, 14-day retention, 30-day conversion to paid, and mean tokens/day for seeded cohort. Need event list: first_5_calls, credit_unlocked, prompt_pack_viewed, webinar_rsvp. I can add a dashboard.
maya: Proposed rollout: 1) backend flag + telemetry (sam/noah) 2) frontend quickstart modal + prompt pack (jules) 3) onboarding email + in-app nudge when credit unlocks (jules) 4) soft canary 10% new signups for 3 days -> ramp. Sam, can you stub the flag and API change? Put a kill-switch.
sam: On it. Quick note re abuse: we should limit unlocked credits to 100 tokens and TTL 14 days. Also rate-limit new keys in first 24h. I'll add guardrails.
jules: Copy variants for modal:
- Variant A: "Try your first 5 requests — get a starter prompt pack + 100 tokens"
- Variant B: "Ship something in minutes — free credits after your 5th API call"
We should also test webinar CTA vs 'open prompt gallery'.
noah: For power calc: to detect a 3pp lift in 14-day retention at p<0.05 we need ~2k new signups per arm. Recommend 2-week run at 10% canary -> estimate 14k signups total? Might need to bump canary or run longer.
maya: Good catch. Maybe do 20% canary for 7 days. Depends on risk appetite.
sam: I created feature flag "first5_credit_pack" (featops-1234) and a kill command. Deploy-bot: added.
deploy-bot: Flag featops-1234 created in /flags with default off. Canary rollout tools: /flags/featops-1234/rollout
jules: I'll draft modal copy, email, and prompt pack (3 templates + short usage tips). Sharing copy in #marketing-drafts by EOD.
noah: I'll add events to pipeline and build a dashboard in Metabase. I'll also add cohort comparison: invited vs control, webinar RSVP overlay.
maya: Ownership: Growth PM (maya) owns experiment; Growth Eng (sam) owns flag + infra; Marketing (jules) owns creative + email; Data (noah) owns metrics and pings.
maya: Next steps: sam to PR infra by Tue, jules to submit creatives Tue, noah to publish dashboard by Wed. We'll sync Thur 30m to decide ramp. @jules @sam @noah any blockers?
sam: no blockers.
jules: none, except need a speaker for the 15m webinar — I can present, but want a senior engineer co-host.
noah: I can co-host for metrics + quick demo.
maya: Perfect — thanks all. :rocket:
